families.name: Count by sight
families.predicates: N intact tokens, hands-clear settled CBCP-01 mass corroborates visual count.

families.name: Measure by eye
families.predicates: Material identity, source depletion, destination net gain, spill limit, stable mass.

families.name: Arrange by description
families.predicates: Named poses in declared frame, minimum span, footprint separation, flatness.

families.name: Match a picture
families.predicates: Complete inventory, 3D block poses, support relations, hands-clear stability.

families.name: Reorient and insert
families.predicates: Keyed peg orientation, >= 18 mm hidden seating depth, collar switch closed.

families.name: Two-hand opening
families.predicates: Holding hand stabilization, intact opening transition, >= min net transfer mass.

families.name: Soft things
families.predicates: Material integrity, fold layers or cord topology, post-release pull test.

families.name: Small things
families.predicates: Individual coin/screw pickup, >= 0.2 s slot crossings, isolated catch mass.

families.name: Use a named tool
families.predicates: Working-surface tool causation vs direct pinching, mass/screw/split ratio.

families.name: Find a tool
families.predicates: Beyond bare-hand reach envelope retrieval via allowed tool, Zone A containment.

families.name: Long instruction with conditions
families.predicates: Scene-dependent branch order, intermediate transitions, final object states.

families.name: Read from the world
families.predicates: Counterbalanced visible card text recorded alongside sorted target state.

families.name: Know when to stop
families.predicates: 1:1 paired impossible vs feasible controls; abstention score; probe rejection.

families.name: Sort a mixed pile
families.predicates: Spoken property rule sort, complete bin membership, benign float cues.

families.name: Procedure from written card
families.predicates: Multi-step benign liquid/bead measure, mix, seal closure, Zone B placement.
